stories.about_desc: Indian hair-care brand making chelating shampoos for hard-water and chlorine damage, founded in Bengaluru by two IIT Roorkee engineering graduates.
stories.summary_line: deSal is a two-founder Bengaluru hair-care brand selling two shampoos for hard-water and chlorine damage, which has published around fifty locality-level articles on Indian water hardness while its own Instagram sits under 700 followers.
keyfacts: What it is | An Indian D2C hair-care brand selling shampoos for hard-water and chlorine damage
Founders | Ankita (chemical engineering) and Akanksha (electrical engineering), both IIT Roorkee alumni
Launched | Around July 2026, inferred from its own Instagram milestone posts; no founding date published
Products | Hard Water Defense Shampoo, 220 ml, listed Rs 764 (MRP Rs 899); Swimmers Wellness Shampoo, 220 ml, listed Rs 806 (MRP Rs 949)
Key ingredient | Disodium EDTA, a chelating agent, at a stated pH of 5.45
Content output | Around 50 published articles, many covering water hardness in individual neighbourhoods
Audience | About 690 Instagram followers; 31 and 9 reviews on its own two product pages
Verification status | No press coverage, funding announcement or named testing labs found; market statistics on its site are uncited
